positions.title: IronHacks Platform Developer
positions.description:
IronHacks is a global virtual open data hacking platform that empowers programmers - from beginners to professionals - to solve civic challenges during a multi-phase and learning-oriented process. The IronHacks platform offers participants a no-set-up programming environment and many powerful features to create novel and useful models and visualizations that help citizens and governments to make better decisions. 

The IronHacks platform is built with React and uses Firebase and Google Cloud API's to provide a reliable and scalable platform for users featuring an integrated code editor, and JupyterHub workspace, and user forum for collaborative problem solving.

company.name: Research Center for Open Digital Innovation (RCODI)

positions.title: DevOps
positions.description:
I've been with the EndoSec team since their beginning in 2013, where I was given the task of designing the company logo, and developing the company website. Some of the work I've done with EndoSec since then includes:

- Setup/support company's onsite server (RHEL Centos7) and remote cloud servers.
- Manage networking & security ensuring remote access for team members and partners.
- Supporting a fully-featured self-hosted Gitlab server (since v9.0) with Mattermost integration and custom build routines.
- Developed project comment-driven documentation utilities and build piplines for documentation creation, and LaTeX compilation.
- Provide expert insight and developer support on web/application software decisions to engineering hardware design team.
- Convert engineers concept sketches and logic into high quality technical diagrams and schematics.
- Create custom tools and interfaces around engineering design tools such GCC, vHDL, and GTKWave.
- Implement open code-based document replacements for traditional business software: wikis, docs, presentations, and one-page reports

Currently acting in a limited advisory/support role.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed custom websites and themes for Wordpress, Magento2, and a Laravel based custom CMS, and any other framework found on traditional LAMP server stack. 

Every project implemented a Vagrantfile to allow production-like testing on the local machine. I gained a lot of experience with Vagrant, Virtual Machine 
development, and provisioning tools such as Chef while working here.

Majority of projects were owned by a single developer, so each developer would also be responsible for managing individual customer relationships, support tickets, design changes and content updates, in addition to platform upgrades, and security issues, while keeping up with their actual development activities. This taught me a lot about multitasking and how to prioritize developer tasks.

Key projects and clients: 
-------------------------
firstib.com - A long-term client and the first FDIC-insured online institution. 

agcrazy.com - A large scale data migration project with over 40,000 products stored in an image file taken from a discontinued SQL server and needed to be ported to a Magento 2.0 store which was still in beta at the time (this was a very hard project, but I learned the value of DevOps tools and automating workflows) 

ADA Reporter - I created an ADA compliance crawler/reporting tool to scan a site of interest ADA compliance issues and would build a history of the score over time.

positions.title: Research Assistant/Data Specialist
positions.description:
Developed tools for enhanced data filter and selection to assist in the Centers Big Data research projects featuring over 100TB acoustic sound recordings from all around the world.  

I was also the informal data visualization / design expert in lab for presentation design, infographics and figures, as well as traditional print media used within the center and at during any of the teams frequent travels.

positions.title: Lead Developer at RecordTheEarth.org
positions.description:
The Record The Earth online citizen science platform for recording sounds in the environment and is part of my MS Thesis. I am in charge of development for both front/back end on web and also the Android mobile app.

www.recordtheearth.org

positions.title: Public Relations & Marketing Chair
positions.description:
Purdue Energy Forum was involved with many events across Purdue, my role on the team was coordinating communications between our industry and government contacts, also to make make sure everyone got their photos taken during the events. 

We hosted over 40 companies and 5 different universities at Purdue for the 4th Annual Indiana Collegiate Energy Summit for a day long conference features, lectues and poster presentations from leading researchers in the field, followed by a tour of Purdue's PUR-1 Nuclear Test Reactor. The event closed with capstone speech by the current Indiana U.S. Senator, Richard G. Lugar, highlighting the importance of our Energy Furture in the US and how the lives of Hoosiers will be direclty affected.

positions.title: Restaurant Owner & Manager
positions.description:
One time I decided to open a restaurant.  I did that while I was still the working full-time as the manager at different store owned by one of the investors of the new store. For the next year I ate lots of noodles, learned a lot about the stock market, and learned how to sleep while standing up. 

When the opportnity was given, I made an exit from this line of business and decided to take a more serious look at my side hobby at the time which was programming. 

Oishi Japanese Grill - Owner/Manager Restaurant 
  - Managed stock and supply-chain
  - Employee Scheduling
  - Media and Design (menus, advertising)

Rice Café - Restaurant Manager
  - 30 Employees (Desk, Drivers, and Kitchen Staff)
  - $100k+ monthly revenue
  - Media & Marketing - print ads, menu, website

educations.fieldOfStudy: Interdisciplinary Science - Earth and Atmospheric Science/Civil Engineering

projects.title: Record the Earth.org - Citizen Soundscape Initiative
projects.description:
The website was one part of several other very large projects going on at the CGS. The websites mission was to facilitate data exploration of all the sound data recorded around the world by the RecordTheEarth app and citizen science programs.

The site launched on Earth Day 2014 and immediately went viral after being featured on 'NBC Today Show' that morning, followed by articles in Wired, Huffington Post, Gizmodo, Discovery News, Engadget, and many others. The site has been featured in NPR Science Friday, PBS Nova, and CNN since.

In addition to the 'explore' map and 'analytics' data tools frontend there are  also extensive backend services and internal team utilities that handle audio file uploading and processing from the app users, sound quality control and bookmarking system, user-logins, sound database exploration tools, and hooks to communicate with other sites and display the upload feed in newer versions of the RtE app.

projects.title: Ross Reserve Living Building Challenge Project
projects.description: Design and build a net-zero energy, net-zero water, ecologically sustainable building for the Purdue Department of Biology. Located at the Purdue Ross Reserve.
